page.title: Daily Driving Time Limit (9h/10h) - Compliance Rules
page.heading: Daily Driving Time Limit (9h/10h)
page.description: Explanation of the 9-hour daily driving limit, the twice-weekly 10-hour extension, and how TachoMobile tracks it.

regulation.title: Regulation
regulation.text: The driver may not drive for more than 9 hours in a single day. This daily driving limit may be extended to 10 hours, but no more than twice within the same week.

extension.title: Extension to 10 Hours
extension.text: The 10-hour extension is only available twice per week. Once a driver has used both extensions in a week, every remaining driving day that week is capped at 9 hours. The weekly counter resets at midnight between Sunday and Monday — the two available extensions become available again at the start of every new week (Monday 00:00), regardless of how they were used the previous week.

tachomobileHandling.title: How TachoMobile Handles This Rule
tachomobileHandling.text: TachoMobile tracks daily driving time against the 9-hour limit and automatically allows the 10-hour extension when needed. The weekly-usage counter on the main screen shows how many of the two available 10-hour extensions have been used in the current week (Monday–Sunday), so the driver can plan remaining days accordingly.

example.title: Example
example.text: A driver drives 9:45 on Monday (1st extension used) and 9:30 on Wednesday (2nd extension used). TachoMobile marks both extensions as used for that week; any further driving day that week is limited to 9 hours. On the following Monday, the counter resets and both extensions are available again.

crew.title: In a Multi-Manning Crew
crew.text: In a multi-manning crew, each driver still has an individual 9-hour daily driving limit, but the twice-weekly extension to 10 hours is not available — every driver in the crew is limited to a flat 9 hours of driving per day, with no extension.
